Scripts.OnEnter: GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_BOTTOMRIGHT") if AAC_SellEditBox:GetText() == "" then GameTooltip:SetAuctionSellItem(AAC_AuctionSellList.list[this:GetParent().index].auctionid) else GameTooltip:SetAuctionSellItem(this:GetParent().auctionid); end if AAC.Patch2502.OwnTooltip then AAC.Patch2502.OwnTooltip(this:GetParent().auctionid) end
GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_BOTTOMRIGHT") if GetAuctionItem() then GameTooltip:SetAuctionItem() else GameTooltip:SetText(AUCTION_GOODS_ICON_PLZ, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0) end GameTooltip:Show()

Scripts.OnTextChanged: if this:GetText() == "" then AAC_SavedSettings.SellAutoFillPercentBidValue = 100 else AAC_SavedSettings.SellAutoFillPercentBidValue = this:GetText() end AAC.Sell.AutoFillPriceFields()

Scripts.OnClick: if GetButtonDelayTime() == nil then SetButtonDelayTime() AAC.Sell.ConfirmButton_OnClick(this, key) end

Scripts.OnTextChanged: if this:GetText() == "" then AAC_SavedSettings.SellAutoFillPercentBuyoutValue = 100 else AAC_SavedSettings.SellAutoFillPercentBuyoutValue = this:GetText() end AAC.Sell.AutoFillPriceFields()

Scripts.OnValueChanged: UIPanelScrollBar_OnValueChanged(this, arg1) if AAC_SellEditBox:GetText() == "" then AAC.Sell.List_UpdateItems() else AAC.Sell.RefreshSellList(); end

Scripts.OnClick: if GetButtonDelayTime() == nil then SetButtonDelayTime() AAC.Sell.ListPromoteButton_OnClick() end
if GetButtonDelayTime() == nil then SetButtonDelayTime() AAC.Sell.ListProlongButton_OnClick() end
if GetButtonDelayTime() == nil then SetButtonDelayTime() AAC.Sell.ListCancelButton_OnClick() end

Scripts.OnEscapePressed: if this:GetText() == "" then this:ClearFocus() else this:SetText( "" ) end
Scripts.OnTextChanged: if this:GetText() == "" then _G[this:GetName() .. "Label"]:SetText( AAC.TradingUI.Text("ownSearch") ) else _G[this:GetName() .. "Label"]:SetText( "" ) end AAC.Sell.MyOffers_OnTextChanged( this:GetText() )
